attack_condition: Initial authority and action bindings are valid. The fresh authority resolver responds at the consequence boundary but returns structured authority-like material that is not an AuthorityState.
pass_criterion: Resolver is invoked exactly once; returned value is not an AuthorityState; execution is refused before consequence with isolated CONSEQUENCE_AUTHORITY_NOT_ESTABLISHED; outbox remains 0 to 0; witness-chain verification succeeds.
nonclaim: Deterministic non-AuthorityState resolver-return test only; no claim over semantic correctness of every AuthorityState, external authority provenance, distributed authority assurance, or production deployment.
